environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod in namespace 'services-hardened' with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile. The node runs a Bottlerocket AMI with immutable root filesystem. A Falco DaemonSet with custom rule macro 'race_condition_signals' triggers on rapid sequential signal delivery (SIGUSR1 followed by SIGTERM within 200ms window) to any process matching the gRPC server binary hash, invoking a response action that freezes the cgroup via the Kubernetes CRI runtime hook. Additionally, the pod spec sets shareProcessNamespace: false and applies a seccomp profile (type: Localhost, localhostProfile: 'profiles/grpc-server.json') that filters sigaction/rt_sigaction for signals other than SIGTERM from PID != 1, meaning only the container init process (tini) can deliver SIGTERM. The shared /tmp volume is replaced with an individual ephemeral volume per container with noexec mount option. The service account token automount is disabled (automountServiceAccountToken: false), so the sa_token read in the signal handler returns empty. An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockSharedPIDNamespace' enforces that no pod in the namespace can set shareProcessNamespace: true.

config.falco_rule: macro: race_condition_signals - detect SIGUSR1+SIGTERM <200ms to grpc-server binary, action: freeze cgroup

seccomp_profile.policy: filter rt_sigaction/sigaction for signals from PID != 1

config.opa_gatekeeper_constraint: K8sBlockSharedPIDNamespace - blocks shareProcessNamespace: true in namespace
